create_precision_at_k_list_meter: create a PrecisionAtKListMeter instance with num_meters, topk_values, and meter_names for multi-output precision@k tracking
build_precision_at_k_from_config: build a PrecisionAtKListMeter from an AttrDict config containing num_meters, topk_values, and meter_names
update_precision_at_k_meter: update a PrecisionAtKListMeter with model output tensors and target tensors to accumulate precision@k statistics
get_precision_at_k_value: get the precision@k meter value as a dict keyed by top-k strings with per-meter percentage results
sync_precision_at_k_state: sync the precision@k meter state across all trainers in distributed training
